data.name: Stolen Grace
data.description: (Greater) When a member of your chosen faith who believes that you are a member of that faith's clergy requests you to cast a cleric spell of a spell level you can cast, you can allow the Heretic to gain 1 point of influence over you and expend a spell slot of the appropriate level to cast the spell.
